summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to announce its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 25/26, 2026, with a record date of May 29/30, 2026. The filing includes proxy materials, notice, and audited financial statements for FY2025 prepared under Singapore FRS. No transaction, tender offer, or special event is disclosed. This is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement filing for an annual meeting. No deal terms, premium, or M&A activity are present.
